Borussia Dortmund has officially extended the contract of head coach Niko Kovac, securing his services until June 30, 2029. The decision comes after a period of positive results under the Croatian's guidance. Kovac, 54, signed the new deal on Tuesday, cementing his future with the eight-time Bundesliga champions.
